C-DACMAP6.what: builder tracked DAC of the banked N5-A plan == harness DAC of N5-A, all tokens

C-LABELEGO.what: every row that built labels (C-DERIV tokens + residual tokens x iterates) and every human future used the nuPlan-DB ego

C-SET.expected_source: banked TF-N5 A1 build report unrepaired_l1.N5A
C-SET.what: builder tracked N5-A DAC-0 set == the banked TF-N5 A1 residual (and, on navtest, == the harness N5-A zero-DAC set)

C-REPLAY.what: the re-run repairs reproduce the banked results (REPAIR-D and L1 return the same applied / not applied as TF-N4 A1 / TF-N5 A1 on every residual token; iterate 0 is the banked plan)

C-DET.what: the whole candidate capture (REPAIR-D + L1, every iterate) run twice on every residual token gives bit-identical plans and scores

C-SELECT.what: the card selector run in the merge on the stored candidates picks exactly what the derive recorded, per arm and token

C-CERT-B6.what: every applied plan, re-scored by a separate scorer call, reproduces its score and passes the arm's CARD certificate against the N5-A builder score (DAC; NC and DDC not worse; builder PDMS strictly better; TTC and C free)

C-ORDER.what: N6-H == N6-T wherever N6-T applies; N6-H differs only through the human candidate, only where no teacher candidate passes

C-X0.what: the deliberate-regression arm (certificate inverted: DAC = 0 required) changes 0 tokens, so its seam is bit-identical to N5-A (a DAC-0 plan has builder PDMS 0)

C-SEAMFN.what: ND.to_navsim reproduces the banked N5-A seam poses bit for bit on every token, so the changed rows are made by the function that made the banked ones
